project.title: Effects of SGLT2 inhibitors in patients undergoing cardiac surgery

review.objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of preoperative or perioperative SGLT2 inhibitor exposure in adult patients undergoing cardiac surgery.
review.question: Among adults undergoing cardiac surgery, does preoperative or perioperative exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors, compared with no SGLT2 inhibitor, placebo, or standard care, improve postoperative outcomes and safety?

elements.label: Population
elements.values: Adults (>=18 years) undergoing cardiac surgery (e.g., coronary artery bypass grafting, valve surgery, aortic surgery)

elements.label: Intervention/Exposure
elements.values: Preoperative or perioperative exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors (e.g., empagliflozin, dapagliflozin, canagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin, bexagliflozin)

elements.label: Comparator
elements.values: No SGLT2 inhibitor use, placebo, or standard care

inclusion: Patients undergoing cardiac surgery (e.g., CABG, valve, aortic)
Preoperative or perioperative exposure to an SGLT2 inhibitor
Comparator includes no SGLT2 inhibitor use, placebo, or standard care
Reports at least one prespecified outcome of interest
Randomized controlled trials or comparative cohort studies
exclusion: Non-surgical or exclusively medical management populations
Not focused on SGLT2 inhibitor exposure or lacks identifiable exposure group

include: Adult human population undergoing cardiac surgery and exposed to an SGLT2 inhibitor in the preoperative or perioperative period
Comparator group present (no SGLT2 inhibitor, placebo, or standard care)
Study design appears to be RCT or comparative cohort
exclude: Not a surgical population or not cardiac surgery
Intervention is not an SGLT2 inhibitor (e.g., GLP-1 RA only, DPP-4 inhibitor only)
Publication type: editorial, commentary, letter without original data, protocol/registration only
unclear: Transcatheter procedures, heart transplantation, or ventricular assist device implantation are mentioned (requires decision)
Conference abstract without clear indication of a corresponding full-text publication (requires decision)
Non-comparative observational designs or case series (requires decision)
Insufficient information in title/abstract to determine exposure timing or presence of comparator

exclusion_reasons.label: Non-human study
exclusion_reasons.description: Study conducted in animals or in vitro.

exclusion_reasons.label: Pediatric population
exclusion_reasons.description: Participants are <18 years old or pediatric surgical population.

exclusion_reasons.label: Not a cardiac surgery population
exclusion_reasons.description: Population does not undergo cardiac surgery.

exclusion_reasons.label: Wrong intervention/exposure
exclusion_reasons.description: Does not involve SGLT2 inhibitor exposure.

exclusion_reasons.label: No comparator group
exclusion_reasons.description: No eligible comparator (no SGLT2i, placebo, or standard care) is present.

exclusion_reasons.label: Not perioperative context
exclusion_reasons.description: Exposure is not in the preoperative or perioperative timeframe relevant to the index surgery.

exclusion_reasons.label: Non-research publication type
exclusion_reasons.description: Editorial, commentary, letter without data, or protocol only.

exclusion_reasons.label: Duplicate or superseded
exclusion_reasons.description: Record duplicates another included study or is superseded by a more complete report.

combination.notes: Primary strategy: Population AND Intervention. Optionally layer a study design filter (C3) in sensitivity searches.

human_decisions_required.question: Should transcatheter cardiac procedures (e.g., TAVR/TAVI, MitraClip) be included as eligible procedures?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: These procedures are not open surgeries and may have different perioperative courses and risks, affecting applicability and heterogeneity.

human_decisions_required.question: Should heart transplantation be included as an eligible cardiac surgery?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Transplant recipients have distinct perioperative and immunologic profiles that may alter SGLT2i risk-benefit and increase heterogeneity.

human_decisions_required.question: Should ventricular assist device (VAD) implantation be included as an eligible procedure?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: VAD implantation patients differ markedly in indications, physiology, and perioperative management, potentially altering SGLT2i effects.

human_decisions_required.question: Should conference abstracts without a corresponding peer-reviewed full text be eligible?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Abstract-only reports often lack methodological detail and complete outcomes; inclusion can bias results and limit risk-of-bias assessment.

human_decisions_required.question: Should non-comparative observational studies (e.g., single-arm series) be eligible?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: The review targets comparative effectiveness/safety; including non-comparative designs may bias effect estimates and hinder pooling.

human_decisions_required.question: Should case series or case reports be eligible?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Case reports/series provide very low-level evidence and can bias safety signals without appropriate denominators or comparators.

human_decisions_required.question: Should comparative case-control studies be eligible alongside cohorts and RCTs?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Case-control designs differ in risk-of-bias (selection/recall) and effect measures, potentially complicating synthesis.

report.summary: Initialized a conservative PICO-based protocol for evaluating preoperative/perioperative SGLT2 inhibitor exposure in adult cardiac surgery patients. Search concepts target cardiac surgery and SGLT2 inhibitors with optional study-design filters. Ambiguities requiring human decisions were surfaced for transcatheter procedures, heart transplantation, VAD implantation, abstract-only evidence, non-comparative designs, case series/reports, and case-control designs. Recommended exclusions preserve a homogeneous surgical population and comparative evidence base.
assumptions: Adult humans only; no language or date restrictions applied by default.
Perioperative period includes preoperative and in-hospital perioperative exposure; exact window to be refined during full-text screening if needed.
Comparator encompasses no SGLT2 inhibitor use, placebo, or standard care.
warnings: Controlled vocabulary candidates require librarian verification.
Do not apply outcomes as mandatory search terms to avoid missing relevant studies.
Operational screening rules for transcatheter procedures, transplantation, VAD, abstracts, and study designs depend on pending human decisions.
